description: Whole figure with circular rings around a central network layout.

components.description: Concentric radial bands forming segmented rings around the perimeter.
Outer thick ring composed of multiple arc segments of varying angular lengths; one segment highlighted with a red outline.
Inner, thinner ring made of many short evenly spaced arc segments with small gaps between them.
Central network composed of clustered nodes and connecting edges, within the inner open area of the circle.
Web of thin straight edges connecting nodes across and between clusters.
Multiple small filled circular nodes (magenta) clustered in groups.

primary.explanation: Multiple arc segments distributed around the outer ring; each item is one angular segment.
Inner ring consists of many short, evenly spaced arc segments arranged around 360 degrees; items vary only along the angle dimension.
Approximate number of edges in the network; edges positioned via node coordinates in 2D cartesian space.
Approximate count of nodes positioned freely in 2D space (scatter layout).
Three cluster backdrops; each cluster forms one area.

secondary.explanation: Each area is defined by a different number of boundary control points.
